result.title: LogicEye: Agent Driven Multimodal Dataset for Interpretable Ophthalmic Diagnosis
result.summary: Clinical adoption of ophthalmic Artificial Intelligence remains limited by low interpretability and a lack of finely annotated multimodal data. Most existing datasets provide only coarse disease labels without the granular pathological findings required for differential diagnosis. We present LogicEye$^{Agent}$, a dual-pool inference and verification agent that emulates clinical reasoning by jointly verifying positive inclusion signs and negative exclusion criteria. Using LogicEye$^{Agent}$, we curate LogicEye$^{Data}$, a large-scale multimodal dataset of 804,461 fundus and OCT images paired with structured pathological reports spanning 38 diseases and 29 subtypes, with quality assured through joint verification by multimodal large language models and clinical experts. Building on this dataset, we further develop LogicEye$^{Bench}$, which incorporates a category-constrained loss for hierarchical disease recognition and report generation. Grounding coarse labels into verified visual findings effectively curtails diagnostic hallucinations and establishes a solid foundation for interpretable vision-language modeling in ophthalmology. The code is available at:https://github.com/Eden35/LogicEye-Agent-Driven-Multimodal-Dataset-for-Interpretable-Ophthalmic-Diagnosis.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作构建 LogicEye 系列资源：用双池推理验证 agent 同时核查阳性纳入征象与阴性排除标准，据此整理出 80 余万张眼底/OCT 图像及结构化病理报告的多模态数据集，并建立含类别约束损失的分层疾病识别与报告生成基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「阳性纳入＋阴性排除」双池验证把粗粒度标签落回可核查的视觉发现，可作为视觉证据筛选与抑制诊断幻觉的现成基准，但论文重点是数据与评测，未涉及 latent 状态生成，可供核查其证据验证流程。
